counting_rules: Tests, native cases, commands, callbacks and versions are different units and are not added into one test count.
Repeated source revisions and host runs are retained separately; the same workloads are not relabeled fresh unseen task populations.
An ok/complete collector or green workflow indicates its finite execution gate, not a positive economic or productivity result.
Unknown human work, missing provider usage and excluded lifecycle costs remain null/unknown, never zero.
Original callback cleanup failure and repaired behavior are distinguished explicitly.

delivered: One production module owns ordered CFG successors, parallel edge values, loan conflicts, linear edge renaming and balanced normal returns.
Verifier, VM and LLVM consume the shared rules; VM step/call/allocation admission and native layout constants share explicit contracts.
Incremental admission binds live rule identity; traps, evaluator stops and cooperative cancellation have distinct outcomes.

pass_conditions: Every accepted opcode and resource transition has an explicit proof scope and a production consumer; unknown or unsupported profiles fail closed.
Native and VM differential evidence includes loops, calls, alias boundaries, allocation failure and cleanup without converting an evaluator stop into a program result.
Any claimed native quota has its own enforcing runtime and measured adversarial boundary tests.
next_acceptance.procedure: Define and implement the full selected operational relation, then prove and independently execute each accepted scalar/resource/CFG/call transition and its normal, trap and allocation-failure outcome.

tracks.title: Shared production semantics and resource rules
unmet_original_acceptance: The complete language does not have a mechanized soundness and progress/preservation proof.
Native lowering is not proved to refine every VM behavior; VM resource budgets are not native RSS/time/stack enforcement.
Rust-class general safety, arbitrary asynchronous cancellation and universal performance non-regression are not established.

delivered: Guarded native publication checks the exact verified Core, emitted IR, target, interface, compiler identity and staged/published bytes; wrong-Core and drift controls reject.
Scalar translation receipts now fingerprint all nine transitive local semantic dependencies and still require current Core admission plus a fresh actual SMT replay.
Existing restricted scalar/guarded optimization profiles retain their declared bounds.

next_acceptance.gate_prerequisites: Actual pinned Z3 for both SMT tests; actual LLVM/Clang and native x86-64 for the binding native tests. A dependency skip is not a pass.
pass_conditions: For each supported category, accept a genuine transformation with independently checked equivalence and bind the result to the final native artifact.
Reject changed traps, alias/lifetime violations, incompatible interfaces, forged receipts and wrong compiled artifacts.
For a peak-resource claim, measure the declared resource on equivalent workloads and include optimizer/proof/build costs; keep unsupported categories open.
next_acceptance.procedure: Implement one explicitly scoped new optimization category and preregister real positive and refusal cases before performance measurement.

tracks.title: Optimization admission, final artifact binding and receipt provenance
unmet_original_acceptance: This delivery does not add a new general loop, composite, cross-module or peak-resource-reduction algorithm.
The scalar translation validator remains an acyclic selected-function profile; calls, loops, memory, FFI and concurrency are outside that validator profile.
A source fingerprint is not proof authority. Whole-program/backend refinement and global optimality remain unproved.
No measured broad performance or peak-memory improvement over Rust has been established.

delivered: Captured two immutable benhoyt/inih source revisions, complete component files and license; all 18 members have explicit dispositions.
GetBoolean, ParseErrorMessage and ValueHandler decision fragments are source-derived Hepta executed through the actual frontend and independent C11/GCC backend.
A native synchronous callback lease adapter checks owner lifetime, thread and reentry constraints and repairs the observed C-parser allocation leak on callback exception.
The real upstream read-error change from 0 to -3 is observed in original and migrated versions.

pass_conditions: Original and translated implementations execute the same normal, failure, callback, lifecycle and real upgrade cases with raw outputs and source identity retained.
Every remaining foreign boundary is explicit; unsupported input refuses without silent fallback or invented safe ownership.
Record human implementation, contract authoring, review and upgrade hours separately from automated build/qualification time before making a low-cost claim.
next_acceptance.procedure: Register a previously unhandled real component/revision before translation, inventory every declaration, and migrate an owned data/resource boundary rather than only wrapping it.

tracks.title: Real INIReader partial migration and callback lifecycle repair
unmet_original_acceptance: 18/18 is a disposition inventory, not full translation coverage. The parser, STL state, formatting, locale normalization and native adapter remain foreign trusted boundaries.
The importer is source-specific to two pinned revisions; arbitrary C/C++ code, layouts, templates, exceptions and asynchronous callbacks are not generally translated.
Exception cleanup is an explicit behavior repair, not an identical exceptional resource trace.
Human migration, contract-review and upgrade work are unmeasured; low migration cost and performance superiority are not established.

delivered: A bounded portfolio model retains the complete acquired-artifact set, resource capacities and own past observations; activation is charged once.
Exact Q32 DP, an independent small exhaustive oracle, fixed and lightweight controls, and the original pinned finite native NDU evaluator execute under one registered objective.
Actual verification, compilation, sealed artifact loading, outputs, evidence writes, original NDU build and declared unknown costs are retained.

next_acceptance.current_executable_gate: python tools/qualify_hia_portfolio_holdout.py --registration-commit FULL_PRIOR_REGISTRATION_SHA --identity PINNED_NATIVE_IDENTITY --native-build-envelope ORIGINAL_BUILD_ENVELOPE --clang ACTUAL_CLANG --output NEW_EVIDENCE_DIRECTORY/portfolio
pass_conditions: At least two nonbaseline complete-horizon alternatives repay their full activation cost and at least two are actually selected/executed under the registered competition gate.
All cases remain correct and within measured budgets, native values/frontiers match the same objective, and complete measured native cost is lower than fixed-best, lightweight and exact-DP controls.

If adding a learned predictor, register separate training and unseen evaluation with equal information, inference/training costs and failure accounting; do not substitute it for the original evaluator without a new study.
next_acceptance.procedure: Before any new measurements, register a realistic workload with genuinely competing independently verified alternatives and exact same-information controls; retain these two negative runs.
next_acceptance.registration_warning: Do not enlarge calls, remove acquisition costs, retune the existing protocol or select a favorable repetition after seeing negative outcomes.

tracks.title: Shared-acquisition portfolio search and original native NDU comparison
unmet_original_acceptance: Both registered executions are economically negative, with no heldout nonbaseline choice and no profitable-choice competition regime.
Native NDU does not beat exact DP, the lightweight control or fixed-best on the measured complete standalone cost.
There is no learned predictor and no demonstrated adaptive advantage on unseen tasks; the second run repeats the same registered workload.
The finite supplied-candidate model is not global program or per-instruction optimality, and NDU supplies no safety authority.

delivered: A whole-module-verified focused context view supplies selected bodies, direct-call interfaces, inventory, explicit omitted context and a requested opcode slice.
Two fresh authored maintenance tasks use the same public RPC, budgets, original-snapshot patches and terminal hidden evaluation in complete-json and focused-json arms.
The real CLI transport preserves raw events and usage, refuses unregistered tool/events, owns process cleanup, and labels scripted controls as ineligible model evidence.
A separate registered amendment admits only the exact observed startup warning multiplicities; the old failed attempt is preserved.

pass_conditions: Every attempted request retains original streams and complete actual usage; every final accepted candidate passes public and one terminal hidden evaluation with resource witnesses.
A descriptive focused-context advantage requires no fewer successful cells, lower complete observed charged units and end-to-end wall time, and no more failed public checks.
Keep startup-warning, registration and usage-limit failures visible. Record no exact unique-token, billing, human-cost or representative-task advantage without the corresponding evidence.
next_acceptance.procedure: After a working provider is available, run a new immutable registered attempt of all four cells without hand-repairing answers or dropping failures.

tracks.title: Focused maintenance context and registered real-provider runner
unmet_original_acceptance: No complete real-provider answer or complete usage receipt was obtained; actual A/B coding efficiency remains blocked.
Raw turn.started events in attempts 01 and 03 prevent claiming that no inference began; unknown token usage is not zero.
Smaller serialized payloads, authored controls and CLI launches do not establish model productivity or replace successful model completions.
Human review time and provider cache effects remain unknown; two authored tasks cannot establish broad agent productivity.

delivered: Actual Hepta callbacks compile and link with the C host on native Linux x86-64 and AArch64 LP64.
Three-worker pthread/eventfd execution observes overlapping work, allocator failures, startup errors, EINTR, completion error, cooperative cancellation and in-process recovery.
Raw resource, descriptor and thread observations remain linked to exact source, compiler and artifact identities; the reference C callback is not linked in Hepta mode.

pass_conditions: Retain real MMIO/DMA/interrupt observations, address/ownership bounds, ordering and cleanup under the registered timeout/error/recovery conditions for every claimed device capability.
Verify measured driver/buffer lifetime, synchronization and failure behavior across the actual foreign boundary; distinguish simulated checks from physical execution.
Qualify each additional ABI/ISA on its real execution environment and keep unsupported targets explicit.
next_acceptance.procedure: Register an exact board/device, host ABI, driver/firmware and resource contract, then execute the claimed device operations on that hardware.

tracks.title: Native Linux pthread/eventfd interfaces and explicit hardware boundary
unmet_original_acceptance: Physical devices, MMIO, DMA, hardware interrupts, kernel drivers and RV64/QEMU execution are not qualified.
These are two direct native host executions, not general cross-target or universal C ABI qualification.
C/pthread/eventfd scheduling and the native wrapper remain trusted; arbitrary concurrent HIA memory safety and preemptive cancellation are unproved.
The meter covers linked component requested payload only, excluding libc/pthread internals, allocator metadata, thread stacks and RSS.
Unavailable inventory verification does not establish that the organization has no physical runner or device.
